metabobAnnotations.annotation: Added impulse_mapping_record table to support impulse learning data storage in SurrealDB. This table captures user intent, impulses created, and task outcomes for pattern recognition. Schema matches ImpulseMappingRecord structure from impulse_learning.py:250-288. Enables centralized learning data collection across all opencode instances instead of local Storage writes. Part of impulse-learning-in-rpc-api-only architectural separation.
metabobAnnotations.designDecision: Used SCHEMAFULL mode to enforce strict schema validation. Created 6 indexes for efficient queries: session lookup, pattern matching, intent classification, quality sorting, temporal analysis, and unique record ID constraint. Array field for impulses allows variable-length impulse lists per turn.
